articles.headline: No. 3 Louisville women use 26-0 run to ease past Alaska Anchorage 113-40 in Great Alaska Shootout
articles.description: — Elif Istanbulluoglu scored 19 points, Imari Berry had 13 of her 16 in the first quarter, and No. 3 Louisville used a big third-quarter run to ease past Alaska Anchorage 113-40 on Saturday night in the Great Alaska Shootout.

articles.headline: NCAA to scrap pregame handshakes at women's tourney after Auriemma-Staley spat
articles.description: The NCAA will encourage but no longer mandate pregame handshakes between head coaches at the women's tournament after last season's controversy involving Geno Auriemma and Dawn Staley.

articles.headline: Harpring scores 20, No. 24 North Carolina women pull away from Alabama

article.story: NASHVILLE, Tenn. -- — Mia Woolfolk scored 19 points, Mikayla Blakes overcame a slow start to add 15 and No. 11 Vanderbilt rolled to an 80-44 win over North Alabama on Wednesday night. Blakes, who now has a 58-game streak scoring double figures, had nine points on 4-of-10 shooting through three quarters before making 2 of 3 shots and two free throws to score the Commodores first six points of the fourth quarter that pushed the lead to 71-30. Aiyan Mitchell had 12 points for Vanderbilt (5-1) and Aubrey Galvan and Jhai Johnson both had 10. Brynn Lusby had 13 points for the Lions (3-2). Vanderbilt cashed in on 28 turnovers with 39 points and outscored North Alabama 50-24 in the paint. Mitchell had the first and last baskets in an 8-0 run that gave Vanderbilt a 19-6 lead. It was 21-11 after one quarter, and a 13-2 start to the second quarter got the lead to 34-13. Vandy led 43-21 at the half. Woolfolk had eight points in a 17-0 run in the third. The lead peaked at 41 in the fourth. Up next North Alabama: Home against Jack State on Monday.
